  "clinical_coverage_for_publication": {
    "coverage_source": "results/clinical_case_mix_coverage_summary.csv",
    "results_paragraph": "Adult common-case-mix standardization succeeded in 208 of 450 Brazilian regions, with 242 excluded by the cell-count requirement and no additional numerical failures among eligible regions. The observed-case-mix RRR was 1.099 (1.079–1.119); uniform weights gave 1.084 (1.063–1.105). In complete-cohort Mexico, 16 of 32 states succeeded, 10 were threshold-ineligible and 6 had numerical failures. The corresponding estimates were 1.055 (0.964–1.155) and 1.075 (0.989–1.169). Both Mexican intervals include one. In the original-gap Mexican comparator, no state yielded a valid standardized estimate: 13 were threshold-ineligible and 19 failed numerically. These analyses do not establish that clinical composition has been removed as an explanation in all units.",
    "chinese_paragraph": "年龄性别病例构成分析在巴西 208/450 个地区成功，观察病例权重结果为 1.099 (1.079–1.119)；其余地区因分层病例数不足未纳入。墨西哥完整队列仅 16/32 州成功，10 州分层病例数不足、6 州数值拟合失败，结果为 1.055 (0.964–1.155)。这部分墨西哥证据的区间跨一，应保留不确定性。"
  },
  "moisture_summary_for_publication": {
    "results_source": "results/moisture_sensitivity_run_20261113/country_pooled_DL_REML_HK.csv",
    "results_paragraph": "All 450 Brazilian regions and 32 Mexican states fitted successfully under all three moisture settings, so common-successful and all-successful memberships were identical. Matched unadjusted effects exactly reproduced the primary unit results. Dew-point and relative-humidity adjustment gave Brazilian RRRs of 1.085 (1.073–1.098) and 1.087 (1.073–1.101); corresponding Mexican RRRs were 1.077 (1.022–1.136) and 1.063 (1.001–1.129). For Mexican relative-humidity adjustment, REML–Hartung–Knapp gave 1.063 (0.999–1.131), with an interval spanning one. Some secondary pairwise diagnosis contrasts also spanned one; moisture robustness was not uniform across every comparison. Excluding the low-land-support Brazilian regions gave the primary RRR 1.099 (1.087–1.111) (k=447).",
    "chinese_paragraph": "湿度补充分析的相同样本基线精确复现主结果。巴西露点和相对湿度调整后分别为 1.085 (1.073–1.098)、1.087 (1.073–1.101)；墨西哥分别为 1.077 (1.022–1.136)、1.063 (1.001–1.129)。墨西哥相对湿度调整在替代汇总下为 1.063 (0.999–1.131)，区间跨一，不能写成所有设定均有确定差异。"
  },

    "clinical_coverage_for_publication": {
      "coverage_source": "results/clinical_case_mix_coverage_summary.csv",
      "results_paragraph": "Adult common-case-mix standardization succeeded in 208 of 450 Brazilian regions, with 242 excluded by the cell-count requirement and no additional numerical failures among eligible regions. The observed-case-mix RRR was 1.099 (1.079–1.119); uniform weights gave 1.084 (1.063–1.105). In complete-cohort Mexico, 16 of 32 states succeeded, 10 were threshold-ineligible and 6 had numerical failures. The corresponding estimates were 1.055 (0.964–1.155) and 1.075 (0.989–1.169). Both Mexican intervals include one. In the original-gap Mexican comparator, no state yielded a valid standardized estimate: 13 were threshold-ineligible and 19 failed numerically. These analyses do not establish that clinical composition has been removed as an explanation in all units.",
      "chinese_paragraph": "年龄性别病例构成分析在巴西 208/450 个地区成功，观察病例权重结果为 1.099 (1.079–1.119)；其余地区因分层病例数不足未纳入。墨西哥完整队列仅 16/32 州成功，10 州分层病例数不足、6 州数值拟合失败，结果为 1.055 (0.964–1.155)。这部分墨西哥证据的区间跨一，应保留不确定性。"
    },
    "moisture_summary_for_publication": {
      "results_source": "results/moisture_sensitivity_run_20261113/country_pooled_DL_REML_HK.csv",
      "results_paragraph": "All 450 Brazilian regions and 32 Mexican states fitted successfully under all three moisture settings, so common-successful and all-successful memberships were identical. Matched unadjusted effects exactly reproduced the primary unit results. Dew-point and relative-humidity adjustment gave Brazilian RRRs of 1.085 (1.073–1.098) and 1.087 (1.073–1.101); corresponding Mexican RRRs were 1.077 (1.022–1.136) and 1.063 (1.001–1.129). For Mexican relative-humidity adjustment, REML–Hartung–Knapp gave 1.063 (0.999–1.131), with an interval spanning one. Some secondary pairwise diagnosis contrasts also spanned one; moisture robustness was not uniform across every comparison. Excluding the low-land-support Brazilian regions gave the primary RRR 1.099 (1.087–1.111) (k=447).",
      "chinese_paragraph": "湿度补充分析的相同样本基线精确复现主结果。巴西露点和相对湿度调整后分别为 1.085 (1.073–1.098)、1.087 (1.073–1.101)；墨西哥分别为 1.077 (1.022–1.136)、1.063 (1.001–1.129)。墨西哥相对湿度调整在替代汇总下为 1.063 (0.999–1.131)，区间跨一，不能写成所有设定均有确定差异。"
    },
